author: Second Wind
description:
Gamescom is here once again, so join us in our watchalong of Geoff Keighley's big showcase. We're expected to see updates on games like Final Fantasy VII: Revelation, Alien: Isolation 2, Fable, The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Songs of the Past, Persona 4 Revival, Mega Man: Dual Override, and more.

If you dig watching us gab over showcases, considering supporting us over at Patreon -- https://www.patreon.com/SecondWindGroup

title: Gamescom Opening Night Live 2026 w/ Second Wind
